card.name: Vallja e Tropojës
card.tagline: Dynamic circle-and-line folk dance of the northern Albanian Alps.
card.profile: Vallja e Tropojës is a traditional Albanian folk dance from the Tropojë region of northern Albania (Gjakova Highlands), known for its dynamic and rhythmic movements reflecting the region's history and social values (English Wikipedia). Traditionally performed in a circle or line, it is accompanied by drums (tupan/daulle), the two-string çifteli, and the fyell (flute), with dancers in traditional attire waving red or yellow scarves. Under the name 'K'cimi dancing of Tropojë' it was inscribed on the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage List in December 2024 (English Wikipedia; UNESCO).
card.insight: A cornerstone of identity for the people of Tropojë and the Gjakova Highlands spanning northern Albania and Kosovo; its 2024 UNESCO listing elevated it into a globally recognized symbol of Albanian heritage (UNESCO).
